judgement.reason: Uploads (avatars, backgrounds, attachments) can move to S3 with a contained change while core data stays in PostgreSQL.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /app/public/user-avatars (Dockerfile), VOLUME /app/public/project-background-images (Dockerfile), VOLUME /app/private/attachments (Dockerfile), volume user-avatars:/app/public/user-avatars (docker-compose.yml 4gaBoards), volume project-background-images:/app/public/project-background-images (docker-compose.yml 4gaBoards), volume attachments:/app/private/attachments (docker-compose.yml 4gaBoards)
reviews.reason: The production image declares volumes for user avatars, project background images and attachments, and no shown setting moves these uploads to S3, so they would be lost on every restart.
